description: Get ownership data for a stock: major holders, institutional/fund ownership, or insider activity.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

holder_type.description: Holder type: major | institutional | mutualfund | insider-transactions | insider-purchases | insider-roster

limit.description:
Maximum entries per page for holder types with a list (institutional,
mutualfund, insider-transactions, insider-roster); omitted = curated
default (25). No-op for major/insider-purchases (no list).

name: get_holders
title: Ownership and Insider Activity
